definition_quote.value: the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, management, behavioral, and social sciences to achieve and maintain client health through the provision of nutrition care services
definition_quote.quote: "Dietetics/nutrition practice" means the integration and application of principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, management, behavioral, and social sciences to achieve and maintain client health through the provision of nutrition care services

value: nutritional assessment of individuals and groups
establishing nutrition priorities, goals, and objectives
developing, implementing, and managing nutrition care systems
evaluating and maintaining standards of quality in food and nutrition care services
ordering appropriate nutritional intake including enteral and parenteral nutrition (within licensed healthcare facility)
ordering appropriate laboratory tests to monitor dietary plan (within licensed healthcare facility)
methods_authorized.quote: Assessing the nutritional needs of individuals and groups based upon appropriate biochemical, anthropometric, physical, and dietary data to determine nutrient needs and recommend to the primary health care provider appropriate nutritional intake including enteral and parenteral nutrition.

license_type_structure.quote: "Licensed dietitian/licensed nutritionist" means a person licensed under this Chapter... "Provisionally licensed dietitian/nutritionist" means a person provisionally licensed under this Chapter.

provisional_license_available.quote: The board may issue a provisional license to any dietitian/nutritionist who presents evidence to the board of successful completion of the education requirements of R.S. 37:3086(C)(1) and (2) for licensure

provisional_license_duration_months.quote: A provisional license may be issued for a period not exceeding one year and may be renewed from year to year for a period not to exceed two years

provisional_license_requires_supervision.quote: A provisional license shall permit the holder to practice only under the supervision of a licensed dietitian/nutritionist.

dietetic_technician_recognized.quote: "Licensed dietitian/licensed nutritionist" means a person licensed under this Chapter. The terms "dietitian", "dietician", and "nutritionist" may be used interchangeably.

rd_credential_accepted_in_lieu_of_state_.quote: Shall have been granted prior to July 1, 1988, the right to use the title "registered dietitian" by the Commission on Dietetic Registration of the American Dietetic Association. Such a person shall be considered to have met the requirements for licensure as provided herein

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: recommend to the primary health care provider appropriate nutritional intake including enteral and parenteral nutrition

diet_order_writing_authority.quote: Within a healthcare facility licensed by the Louisiana Department of Health, ordering appropriate nutritional intake, including enteral and parenteral nutrition, and ordering appropriate laboratory tests to monitor the effectiveness of the dietary plan, subject to the approval of and authorization by the licensed healthcare facility's medical staff or bylaws.

lab_test_ordering_authority.quote: ordering appropriate laboratory tests to monitor the effectiveness of the dietary plan, subject to the approval of and authorization by the licensed healthcare facility's medical staff or bylaws.

exempt_professions_list.quote: Persons licensed to practice the professions of dentistry, medicine, osteopathy, chiropractic, nursing, or pharmacy from engaging in the practice of dietetics/nutrition when incidental to the practice of their profession

federal_employee_exemption.quote: A dietitian/nutritionist who is serving in the Armed Forces or any other federal agency from engaging in the practice of dietetics/nutrition provided such practice is related to service or employment.

weight_control_program_exemption.quote: A person from providing weight control services through a program which has been reviewed by, consultation is available from, and no program change can be initiated without prior approval by a licensed dietitian/nutritionist

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: A person from marketing or distributing food, food materials, or food supplements or a person from engaging in an explanation of the use or preparation of these products, or from furnishing general nutrition information related to such products in connection with the marketing or distribution of such products, if that person does not represent himself as a dietitian or nutritionist.

nonresident_temporary_practice_allowed.quote: A nonresident registered dietitian/nutritionist from practicing dietetics/nutrition in Louisiana for five days without a license or up to thirty days per year with licensure from another state if the requirements for licensure are substantially equal to the requirements contained in R.S. 37:3086.

nonresident_temporary_practice_max_days.quote: A nonresident registered dietitian/nutritionist from practicing dietetics/nutrition in Louisiana for five days without a license or up to thirty days per year with licensure from another state
